name: content-cache.parents
title: Status Content Cache Parents
description: The status item that reports information about the Content Cache service parent caches.

payloadkeys.title: Content cache parents
payloadkeys.content: An array of dictionaries that describes parent Content Caches.

subkeys.title: Parent GUID
subkeys.content: The unique identifier of the parent Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Indicates removal of the entry.
subkeys.content: If `true`, the system removed the parent entry and only this key and the `identifier` key are present in the status item object.

subkeys.title: IP address
subkeys.content: The local IPv4 address of the parent Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Port
subkeys.content: The IP port number the parent Content Cache listens to for requests.

subkeys.title: Cache health
subkeys.content: If `true,` the parent Content Cache is able to respond to requests from this Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Version
subkeys.content: The version number of the parent Content Cache software.
